messages:
Customer: Hey @support — seeing 401 "Billing required" in the browser when calling /v1/chat. Happens intermittently for a subset of users. Response header included x-request-id=rid_9f2b. Can collect whatever helps to repro.

Alyssa (Support): Thanks — we can usually diagnose this quickly with a HAR + console logs and a curl repro. Please follow the steps below and attach the files: .har (network), console text, and one curl command reproduced from the failing request.

Alyssa (Support): Quick checklist (short): 
• Open DevTools (F12 / Cmd+Option+I)
• Network tab: check "Preserve log" and "Disable cache"
• Reproduce the failure in the app
• Right-click the top of the Network list -> "Save all as HAR with content" -> name it something like customer-<date>-rid_9f2b.har
• Console tab: copy errors (right-click -> Save as...) or select -> copy and paste into a text file console-rid_9f2b.txt

Jordan (SRE): If you prefer to paste a curl, do this after reproducing: right-click the failing request -> Copy -> "Copy as cURL (bash)". Paste here and redact your API key before uploading. Example (redact token):

```bash
# example, replace with the copy-from-devtools output and redact token
curl 'https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data-raw '{"model":"gpt-4o","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"test"}]}' \
  --compressed

# To print response headers too: add -i or -D -
# e.g. curl -i -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' ...
```

Jordan (SRE): We specifically need the response headers to capture x-request-id and any billing error code from the API. In curl you can capture response headers like: `curl -i ...` and paste the full response headers/HTTP status.

Samir (DevTools Bot): Browser specifics:
• Chrome/Edge: Network -> right-click -> "Save all as HAR with content". Console -> three-dot menu -> "Save as..." or select & copy.
• Firefox: Network -> "Save all as HAR". Use "Persist Logs".
• Safari: enable "Develop" menu (Safari -> Preferences -> Advanced -> Show Develop menu), then Develop -> Show Web Inspector -> Network -> right-click -> "Export HAR" (or use "Export -> Export HAR"). Console messages can be right-clicked and copied.

Alyssa (Support): Important privacy steps before upload: 
1) Redact Authorization header (replace token with "REDACTED") in any saved curl or plain-text request.
2) Remove or mask any PII (emails, user IDs) in the HAR if present. You can zip the HAR and include a small note of redactions.
3) Keep the original filename and include the x-request-id in the filename if possible (helps SRE mapping).

Alyssa (Support): Where to upload: attach to this thread or use our secure upload: https://support.redwood.ai/upload (please include case number if you have one). If file is >50MB, please use the upload link and paste the returned URL here.

Jordan (SRE): If you can't attach a HAR, at minimum paste: 
• The failing request method/path and full request payload (body)
• Response status code + response headers (must include x-request-id)

Customer: Thanks — I have the HAR and console txt. Uploading now. Do you want the raw curl copy too?

Alyssa (Support): Yes please, paste the cURL (redacted) or attach it. Once we have the HAR + console + curl + x-request-id, we'll map the request on the backend and follow up with the exact billing error details. :thumbsup:

Customer: Uploaded files and pasted the redacted curl. Let me know if you need anything else.

Alyssa (Support): Perfect — we'll take it from here. I'll loop in billing team if we see the subscription/usage rejection. Expect an update within 2 business hours.

Jordan (SRE): If we need live repro access, we may ask for a temporary test account or a short screen-sharing session to reproduce in our environment.

Customer: Happy to screen-share if needed. Thanks!
